type.name: Country on a map
type.description: Two cards per country on a real world map: name the highlighted country, and find a named country by tapping it. Zoom and pan; small countries get a tap target. Checked by script; typos and other languages' names are forgiven, but naming a different country never is.

fields.name: country
fields.description: Country name, as shown after answering.

fields.name: map
fields.description: Natural Earth ADM0_A3 code of its shape on the map (e.g. BRA).

fields.name: region
fields.description: Africa, Asia, Europe, North America, Oceania or South America: which part of the map the card opens on.
